verdict.rationale: Salv's transaction monitoring page says compliance teams can start from a scenario library and adjust each scenario's type, threshold and segments, or add their own scenarios. Supporting rule-configuration features include per-scenario real-time mode, alert suppression intervals and backtesting against up to a year of history. Missing for 10: detailed docs on how thresholds vary per segment (only a marketing-level mention of adjusting threshold and segments), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a compliance-officer, I can configure transaction monitoring rules and segment-specific thresholds

citations.quote: Start from the library and adjust each scenario's type, threshold and segments, or add your own alongside them.
Set an alert suppression interval so a repeating customer doesn't re-alert every day.
Run any scenario version against up to a year of your own history, with no real alerts, and see what it would have caught
